scope: All three final finite bundles, complete entrypoint/runner/tests/protocol/supplemental manifest, disabled qualification and README. CPU-only; no model/GPU/engine/HTTP/browser calls.

findings.defect: Cancellation qualification does not bind the original consumed input bytes. Intent contains input_sha256 but envelope entrypoint omits it; cancellation raw_response may be null. Runner only validates current canceled input packet and worker argument paths, so a changed input at the same path can be rebound after execution.
findings.required_repair: Retain intent input byte SHA in final entrypoint metadata and require it against completion/cancellation bound input bytes; regression for same-path canceled input mutation.

findings.defect: Declared independent actual entrypoint qualification review is not an admission binding. Current ten bindings include training/held audits, eligibility, and both input/envelope/worker trios, but no original independent qualification audit.
findings.required_repair: Bind a qualification review wrapper and original report covering both exact trios and source/protocol; require eligibility to reference that audit SHA. Validate canceled envelope via _check_envelope so any returned raw is also checked. Treat this as local-agent engineering evidence, not human expert validation.

positive_checks: Shipped availability remains false. No existing server, launcher, frontend, trainer, evaluator or corpus source changed.
Only exact fixed step64 adapter is loaded before inference; response.raw.json and nested raw_response remain unchanged.
Input is restricted to present FEN, legal consecutive prior FENs and optional legal selected move; future/score/PV fields rejected.
Outside source dependencies require exact explicit manifest paths/hashes; traversal and external symlink substitutions reject.
Shared worker owns child lifetime; 180-second argument yields 210-second outer cap, correctly disclosed.
No activation or model quality approval follows CPU source review.
